canonical_statement: Provisional scope: for a finite-dimensional continuous semimartingale X and a scalar twice continuously differentiable function f, f(X_t)-f(X_0) is the sum of the coordinate stochastic integrals of the first derivatives of f against X and one half of the Hessian terms integrated against the coordinate quadratic covariations of X.
domain_and_universes: provisional: finite coordinate type, probability sample type, real time, real-valued coordinate processes; exact universes and measurable structures remain to be frozen
quantifiers: time t in the selected interval
hypotheses: all stochastic integrals and quadratic covariations in the selected formulation exist
conclusion: the multidimensional Ito identity from initial time to t

alternate_encodings.target: Brownian formula with quadratic variation equal to time

alternate_encodings.relationship: strictly different extension, excluded from the provisional root unless primary-source audit requires it

excluded_degenerate_cases: No silent exclusions. t = 0, constant and affine f, zero/one-dimensional coordinates, and finite-variation paths are required boundary probes.
foundation_profile: rev-5.6 profile not yet instantiated; classical/choice/quotient and measure-theoretic policies remain open
tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel plus pinned mathlib intended; exact toolchain and transitive closure remain open
computation_profile: No computation, oracle, or numerical approximation is credited at intake
source_revisions: See source_statement_crosswalk.md; immutable source copies and hashes require the anchor-audit phase
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on changes to the selected Ito variant, domains, Lean target, imports/toolchain, source pins, foundation/TCB policy, or rev-5.6 standard.
status_boundary: This planned intake maps and narrows scope. It does not resolve the source ambiguity, pass statement elaboration, accept the legacy Lean module, or prove the Ito formula.
